name: @pipeworx/mcp-dostuff

tools.name: metros
tools.description: List the metros DoStuff covers (slug + name). Pass a slug to the events tool.

tools.name: events
tools.description: Curated things-to-do / events for a DoStuff metro. Defaults to today; pass `date` and/or `days` to cover a window (e.g. a weekend). Optionally filter by category (music, art, performing-arts, comedy, food-drink, other-fun-deals) and free-only. Sorted by start time.

metro.description: Metro slug: nyc, chicago, boston, austin, san-antonio, sf-bay, la, seattle, denver, san-diego, portland, dallas, houston, nashville, philadelphia, indianapolis, kansas-city, louisville, st-louis, vancouver, victoria. Use the metros tool to list.

date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, US Eastern).

days.description: How many days from the start date to include (1-7, default 1). Use 3 for a weekend.

free_only.description: If true, only return free events.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dostuff forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dostuff pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
